summary: Frontend-only validation for Qloud Audio additions completed on public preview URL. Core nav/promo/footer links and GA4 qloud_audio_click tracking work. Two issues remain: homepage console error and missing crawler-readable /catalog and /build links in production HTML source.

ui_bugs.issue: Console logs an error on load: 'Received `%s` for a non-boolean attribute `%s` ... jsx'. This violates the no-console-errors acceptance condition.
ui_bugs.selector: https://assets.emergent.sh/scripts/emergent-main.js:55:30 (trigger appears with <style jsx> usage in app)

integration_issues.issue: Root HTML source contains Qloud Audio relationship (subOrganization) but does not contain explicit crawler-readable https://www.qloudaudio.com/catalog or https://www.qloudaudio.com/build links.

action_items: Fix JSX attribute warning source (likely <style jsx> in /app/frontend/src/components/Process.jsx) so homepage loads cleanly without console errors.

Ensure deployed/served production HTML includes crawler-readable links to https://www.qloudaudio.com/catalog and https://www.qloudaudio.com/build (in JSON-LD or prerendered fallback content), not only the base qloudaudio.com URL.
critical_code_review_comments: App currently uses <style jsx> pattern in a CRA React component (/app/frontend/src/components/Process.jsx). This is a Next.js-specific pattern and causes React DOM attribute warnings in this stack.
There is a build/runtime mismatch risk: seo-build.js includes fallback content with catalog/build links, but the served root HTML on preview does not expose these links to crawlers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use public URL from frontend/.env: https://qloud-seo-refactor.preview.emergentagent.com. Verified passing: desktop/mobile Qloud Audio nav links, promo CTA links (/catalog and /build), footer mention/link, GA4 qloud_audio_click event in dataLayer, and no horizontal overflow on 1920x800 and 390x800. Failing checks are console error and missing crawler-readable catalog/build links in root HTML source.
rca of the issue: (1) Console error RCA: component code uses unsupported JSX attribute pattern (<style jsx>) in CRA React, producing non-boolean attribute warning rendered as console error. (2) Crawler HTML RCA: runtime served HTML appears to include only base Qloud Audio relationship URL; explicit catalog/build links expected from prerender/fallback are absent in delivered root source, indicating deployment path or template/content mismatch.
